fact: As of 4 November 2026 Gabon's housing ministry is preparing a digital cadastre with a pilot in Estuaire/Greater Libreville after a 14 September 2026 protocol with SNEDAI, the specifications are not final, and the ministry has deployed the Ogooue application and is preparing online tracking of land files.
title: Cadastre numérique : le Gabon prépare un fichier unique des parcelles, en commençant par l'Estuaire
